title: Paper-4-1 major-revision reproducible analysis package

variable_definitions.tcp_total: event-total TCP over China land cells, area-weighted, 10^6 m^3
variable_definitions.tcp_depth: area-weighted mean event depth over wet China cells, mm
variable_definitions.affected_area: wet China cell area (>0.5 mm), km^2
variable_definitions.NDAYS_group: active-MJO days (amplitude>=1) in season with phase in group
variable_definitions.ratio_no_modulation: rate / (total events / total active days); 1.0 = null

significance: two-sided alpha=0.10; phase tests use residence-time permutation null; field composites use one-sample t=composite*sqrt(n), |t|>1.645
